selection: Keep prospective targets if physically feasible; otherwise select closest feasible ordered candidate to each target with proximal < .72 < distal. Use only pre-dynamic geometry/installation/unchanged thresholds. Never use task-arm results.
installation_rule: Center in distal half; sleeve and cuff-bar axial extents within the shank. Also report whether full sleeve lies in distal half; no unrequested positive installation margin added.
geometry_pass: Original source envelope minima >= original scorer clearance floor; physical body/table penetration absent. Static interpolation is necessary-only.
